`cremona_aplist_le300.txt` is an unmodified excerpt (the lines for
conductors N <= 300) of `aplist/aplist.00000-09999` from John Cremona's
elliptic curve data, https://github.com/JohnCremona/ecdata, distributed
under the Artistic License 2.0. Each line has the conductor, the
isogeny class, and a_p for the 25 primes p < 100 (at primes dividing the
conductor, the sign of the Atkin-Lehner eigenvalue).
